description:
[Wicked Identity] Public RS256 keys to verify an assertion_token locally. Free. Set sandbox=true for the separate key set that signs sandbox assertions.

Use when you want the public keys to verify an assertion token locally. Not for checking a wallet's status (use identity_status).

Behavior: read-only.

sandbox.description: true = the sandbox key set (issuer wicked-identity-sandbox).

name: identity_jwks
